facility.name: Papa & Nanas Child Care
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care

provenance.note: Census Geocoder Exact match: 11301 HORNSBY ST, AUSTIN, TX, 78753

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Immunizations-Docs may be official record or copy that have signature of health care prof. or name of other prof who administered vaccine: A child's immunization record did not have a healthcare professionals stamp or signature.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunizations-Docs may be official record or copy that have signature of health care prof. or name of other prof who administered vaccine (26 TAC §746.623(2)(D))

occurrences.finding: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly: The fire extinguisher was not inspected in the months of February or March of 2025.  This was corrected at inspection when the provider inspected it during inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Inspect Fire Extinguishers Monthly (26 TAC §746.5307(a))

occurrences.finding: Smoke Detectors Testing: The smoke detectors were not tested in the month of March of 2025. This was corrected at inspection when the director conducted the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Smoke Detectors Testing (26 TAC §746.5319)

occurrences.finding: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly: The carbon monoxide detection system was not tested in the month of March of 2025. This was corrected at inspection when the director conducted the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic or Battery-Operated Carbon Monoxide Detector-Check All Detectors Monthly (26 TAC §746.5537(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: One child did not have current immunization records.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: One child did not have a statement of the child's health from a health-care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: The operation conducted a fire drill in January of 2025 and did not exit in 3 minutes or less.  The operation did not conduct a fire drill in the month of March of 2025.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System: The provider is not consistently using a sign-in and sign-out tracking system daily.  The provider is also not including the required information daily on the tracking system in place such as: the name of each child; the date, time of arrival, and time of departure; and the employee or parent's initials or other unique identifier.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sign-in and Sign-out Tracking System (26 TAC §746.631(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: Conditions on a background check were not being followed when the subject was found during an investigation to have been alone with children and caring for them.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: One caregiver did not have current training in pediatric CPR.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance: The provider did not have attendance records or time sheets listing all days and hours worked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Records Maintained and Made Available - Employees' Attendance (26 TAC §746.801(5))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: Conditions on a background check were not being followed when the subject was observed alone with a child while taking them to the bathroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Four personnel files were reviewed:    3 were missing a record of training hours  4 were missing proof of request for a background check
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge: Two caregivers present did know who was in charge during the director's absence or for how long.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Two children were missing a statement of the child's health from a health-care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: The snacks did not follow the meal patterns established by the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) Child and Adult Care Food Program (CACFP) that is administered by the Texas Department of Agriculture.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: Two caregivers did not have proof of current pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: Two caregivers did not have current pediatric cardiopulmonary resuscitation (CPR).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Two people were present without eligible background checks, and left during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: The plastic nap mats being used during inspection were not labeled with the child's name.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: One infant was observed asleep in a restrictive device.  The caregiver moved the infant from the restrictive device into a crib during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge: Two caregivers present did know who was in charge during the director's absence or for how long.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director's Absence -  Caregiver in Charge Knows in Charge (26 TAC §746.1013(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: Four personnel files were reviewed:    1 was missing dates of hire  1 was missing docmentation showing how the employee meets the minimum age and education qualifications  1 was missing a A Pre-Employment Affidavit form 2912  4 were missing a record of training hours  2 were missing a photo ID  3 were missing proof of request for a background check  1 was missing a statement dated/signed showing that the staff recieved a copy of operational and personnel policies
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Seven children were left unsupervised in a classroom while the caregiver answered the door.  This was corrected when the caregiver returned to the classroom after answering the door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: Children's records on file were missing the release form from the physician.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns: Meals served do not meet the nutritional requirements established by the U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA).
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Follow Meal Patterns (26 TAC §746.3301(b))

occurrences.finding: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions: Meals do not reflect the posted menu, and substitutions are not tracked.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Daily Menus - Record Comparable Substitutions (26 TAC §746.3313(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: It is alleged that a caregiver with conditions on the background check was alone with a child or group of children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A child under the age of two was allowed screen time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Based on the evidence obtained it was found a child was left unsupervised. A caregiver left the room to answer the front door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: A staff member did not have current first aid training updated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: A staff member did not have current CPR training updated.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing: A staff member did not have current first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric First Aid with Rescue Breathing (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(3)(A))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Paint was found chipping off the wall in the front and in a classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization: During a DFPS investigation it was found that the operation did not report an injury that required medical attention.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Report Child Injury Requiring Medical Treatment by a Health-Care Professional or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.305(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation: During a DFPS investigation it was found that time out periods being used can be up to 5-10 minutes in length.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Brief Supervised Separation (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(D))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR: A staff member did not have current CPR training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Caregiver supervising children in care did not have a complete background check on file.     This was corrected when the caregiver was asked to leave the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: Based on the information obtained it was determined that the infant room did not have adequate lighting during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised: During naptime, the caregiver will sit in the hallway to supervise napping children in two different classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Arrangement of Napping Equipment -All Children Supervised (26 TAC §746.2909(5))
